title: App Mafia: how Zach Yadegari and co-founders scale consumer apps with influencers, controversy and speed
summary: Zach and the App Mafia crew (Cal AI, Quitter, Umax) explain how they scale hard-paywalled consumer apps: direct-response influencer marketing, occasional big mindshare bets like a $500K MrBeast sponsorship, controversy for reach, a tiny critical path, speed and bootstrapped risk-taking.

principles.text: Run marketing as direct response: price each influencer post against expected return, and scale only what is profitable.
principles.quote: pretty much most of our strategy comes down to direct response. It's not a lot of the whole brand awareness game. It's mostly, okay, we know we're paying this much for an influencer to post and we're going to get this much back

principles.text: Take occasional big mindshare bets (e.g. MrBeast) when second-order effects like trust, hiring and word of mouth justify it.
principles.quote: it's Mr. Beast, we know that there will be all of these second degree effects where working with him makes us more trustworthy with other brands.

principles.text: Climb up the influencer ladder gradually; pay for bigger names as revenue grows, and take bets that are survivable.
principles.quote: we have scaled up Cali almost only through influencers. Only recently are we starting to run paid ads like Facebook pay-per-click ads. And so we've just been working our way up to more and more famous influencers

principles.text: Focus 80% of time on the few metrics that matter in a hard-paywall app: downloads, conversion, retention; let small fires burn.
principles.quote: there are only really three things like Cali hard paywalled apps that truly matter. It's one getting people to download, two is converting the downloads and then three is getting them to stay.

principles.text: Ship fast and imperfect early; speed builds momentum and intuition, and killing a failed launch video quickly beats perfectionism.
principles.quote: the more decisions you make the the more data you And the stronger your intuition grows over time. If you do nothing, your intuition and and your your mental models are never going to form

principles.text: Controversy and social reach are a hiring and distribution advantage; avoiding risk out of ego limits influence.
principles.quote: The more algorithmic reach and distribution that you have, the higher quality talent that you can attract.
